resources.string: Clear this app’s saved hosts and sign-ins?

This closes the current view and clears ALL host cookies, sign-ins, origin-local drafts and view storage, cached web data, and the remembered host address in this app. This applies to every host, not only the current host. Host-owned sessions and processes are not deleted or stopped. This cannot be undone.
Clearing all saved hosts and sign-ins… Reconnect is disabled until deletion is complete.
All saved host addresses, host cookies, and local drafts and view storage in this app were cleared. Connect to sign in again. Host sessions are unchanged.
Update Android System WebView or Chrome to clear all local data safely. This provider does not support confirmed browsing-data deletion. No local data or remembered host address has been removed.
Local-data removal did not complete. Update Android System WebView or Chrome and try Clear saved hosts and sign-ins again. Reconnect remains disabled to prevent old data from being restored.
